provenance.assetUrlsExpire: Figma asset URLs (figma-alpha-api S3) are valid for 14 days from export

screenshots.note: excatfigma get_screenshot returns the image inline to the agent only; it exposes no file path or byte stream, so Figma PNGs could not be saved to _figma/. Screenshots were still fetched and used for visual comparison during verification.

assemblyNotes: Teaser card row gap 40px taken from Figma "Element type=2 Teasers, Breakpoint=Desktop" (12542:1504).

class="container" (max-width 1180px, centred) used only around frames that are themselves 1180px wide (Block Content elements, Teaser Text+Image 574+32+574, Button variants row, teaser card rows); Tailwind's own container plugin disabled to avoid conflict.
Fonts Lexia/Inter are not loaded (not part of the Figma export); the exported font stacks are kept verbatim.
Block Content (12552:3653) is a documentation frame; desktop variants of its .Block Element set (12534:1413) exported: Title + Text (12534:1405) and Listing Card (12534:1414).
Button (12077:109023) is a page; exported the "Button variants" row 12084:109282 (primary, secondary, tertiary, link + icon-only, default state).
